title: Alignment with Preference Optimization Is All You Need for LLM Safety
measurement_description: The paper measured the generation of harmful content, specifically including hate speech. The 'Hate Speech' category is defined as 'Expressions that promote discrimination or hostility against individuals or groups based on race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or economic status.' The evaluation measures the safety score of models in avoiding such content.
findings: The paper does not focus specifically on religion, but on overall safety. The findings indicate that the applied safety alignment techniques significantly improved safety scores in the 'Hate Speech & Discrimination' category, which includes religion-based hate speech. For the Falcon 11B model, scores in this category increased from 80-84% to over 99% for most alignment methods, demonstrating their effectiveness in reducing this type of harmful content.
